question: does the bilevel MILP find a growth-coupled D-lactate design in iML1515 when given hours instead of the hardcoded 1800 s, anaerobically, at a 3-knockout bound?
why_this_run_exists: dna_decode/fba/design.py:290 hardcodes time_limit=1800 and no CLI flag exposes it, so the overnight CLI arms could not use the budget they were given. Both returned status=time_limit with n_designs=0, which is the solver giving up rather than a measured absence.
two_improvements_over_the_cli_arms: time_limit raised from the hardcoded 1800 s to 12600 s per arm.
max_knockouts raised 2 -> 3; published growth-coupled D-lactate strains are multi-knockout.

arms.READING: The solver STOPPED on its own time limit with no design in hand. This is NOT a measured absence of designs -- the search was truncated, so this arm makes no claim in either direction.
